## Liquid Glass as see-through as on iOS 26
- On phones nothing dark sits behind the floating tab bar and mini player any more: the page runs on underneath them, like on the iPhone
- The tab bar, the player and the side bar are much clearer glass: you see the page through them, bent at the rounded edges
- Menus, sheets and dialogs are lighter and clearer too, with just enough frost to keep the text easy to read
- With your own background picture the bars keep a little more veil, so their labels stay readable
- Taps in the gap around the bars still don't reach the page behind
- Only Liquid Glass changes, Standard and Green stay as they are

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
